args.sql:
WITH oqf AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.observstation, 
    -- Calculate Observation Quality Factor (OQF)
    (
      t1.atmostransparency * t1.lunardistdeg * t2.pointaccarc
    ) AS calculated_score,
    -- Classify Observational Confidence Level (OCL)
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency > 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Operational' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Degraded' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Due' THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
  FROM 
    observatories AS t1
    JOIN telescopes AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
),
site_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation, 
    ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ] AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    ARRAY_LENGTH(
      ARRAY[
        equipstatus, procqueuestatus
      ]
    ) AS issues_count
  FROM 
    telescopes
)
SELECT 
  t1.observstation AS name,
  t3.telescregistry AS "telescope ID",
  t2.calculated_score,
  si.equipment_problems,
  si.issues_count,
  t2.confidence_level
FROM 
  observatories AS t1
  JOIN oqf AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
  JOIN telescopes AS t3 ON t1.observstation = t3.observstation
  JOIN site_issues si ON t1.observstation = si.observstation
ORDER BY 
  t2.calculated_score DESC;

events.sql:
SELECT 
  t1.observstation AS name, 
  t2.telescregistry AS "telescope ID", 
  calculated_score, 
  ARRAY[t2.equipstatus, t2.procqueuestatus] AS equipment_problems, 
  issues_count, 
  confidence_level 
FROM 
  observatories AS t1 
  JOIN telescopes AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation;

WITH oqf AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.observstation, 
    -- Calculate Observation Quality Factor (OQF)
    (
      t1.atmostransparency * t1.lunardistdeg * t2.pointaccarc
    ) AS calculated_score,
    -- Classify Observational Confidence Level (OCL)
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency > 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Operational' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Degraded' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Due' THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
  FROM 
    observatories AS t1
    JOIN telescopes AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
),
site_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation, 
    ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ] AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    ARRAY_LENGTH(
      ARRAY[
        equipstatus, procqueuestatus
      ]
    ) AS issues_count
  FROM 
    telescopes
)
SELECT 
  t1.observstation AS name,
  t3.telescregistry AS "telescope ID",
  t2.calculated_score,
  si.equipment_problems,
  si.issues_count,
  t2.confidence_level
FROM 
  observatories AS t1
  JOIN oqf AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
  JOIN telescopes AS t3 ON t1.observstation = t3.observstation
  JOIN site_issues si ON t1.observstation = si.observstation
ORDER BY 
  t2.calculated_score DESC;

WITH oqf AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.observstation, 
    -- Calculate Observation Quality Factor (OQF)
    (
      t1.atmostransparency * t1.lunardistdeg * t2.pointaccarc
    ) AS calculated_score,
    -- Classify Observational Confidence Level (OCL)
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency > 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Operational' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Current' THEN 'High'
      WHEN t1.atmostransparency BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.5 
        AND t2.equipstatus = 'Degraded' 
        AND t2.calibrstatus = 'Due' THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS confidence_level
  FROM 
    observatories AS t1
    JOIN telescopes AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
),
site_issues AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation, 
    ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ] AS equipment_problems,
    -- Count the number of issues
    ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY[
      equipstatus, procqueuestatus
    ], 1) AS issues_count
  FROM 
    telescopes
)
SELECT 
  t1.observstation AS name,
  t3.telescregistry AS "telescope ID",
  t2.calculated_score,
  si.equipment_problems,
  si.issues_count,
  t2.confidence_level
FROM 
  observatories AS t1
  JOIN oqf AS t2 ON t1.observstation = t2.observstation
  JOIN telescopes AS t3 ON t1.observstation = t3.observstation
  JOIN site_issues si ON t1.observstation = si.observstation
ORDER BY 
  t2.calculated_score DESC;
